roughness.png.role: Roughness map, green channel consumed by MotionLoom

processing: Selected outputs copied without modifying pixels. metrics.json computed by read-only image analysis.
limitations: Built-in generation returned 1774x887 despite a request for a higher-resolution 2:1 atlas.
AI-generated edges are approximately continuous; exact seamless pixel equality is not guaranteed. Measured horizontal seam error is approximately 1.7 to 2 times adjacent-pixel error.
Companion maps are generated independently against the same coordinate reference. Feature registration is visually close but not a deterministic pixel-perfect reconstruction.
Roughness map green-channel median is approximately 0.588 rather than the requested 0.69; adjust material roughness factor if preserving previous effective roughness.
Normal map has a small mean tangent-space bias and strong outlier slopes around some lenticels. Use restrained normalScale.
